page.content:
Scientist-sovereign of the Candy Kingdom.

How Princess Bubblegum connects

  • Faction: Candy Kingdom — Princess Bubblegum rules the Candy Kingdom.
  • Series: Adventure Time (series) — Princess Bubblegum is a central sovereign of the series.
  • Character: Marceline — Marceline and Bubblegum share a long, repaired history.
  • Character: Ice King — The Ice King's early bit is kidnapping princesses, especially Bubblegum.

What is Princess Bubblegum?

Princess Bubblegum is the candy monarch and biochemist who built her people, spies on threats, and carries the moral gray of ruling Ooo's sweetest state.

Key threads lead to Candy Kingdom, Adventure Time (series), Marceline and Ice King.
